description: This is a Java source file implementing the DeviceConnectionClient interface for Eclipse Hono's device connection API. It defines a class DeviceConnectionClientImpl that provides methods for setting and getting the last known gateway for a device, and manages AMQP links for communication.

classes.name: DeviceConnectionClientImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the DeviceConnectionClient interface, providing methods to interact with Hono's Device Connection service over AMQP.

methods.name: setLastKnownGatewayForDevice
methods.description: Sets the last known gateway for a specific device via the Device Connection API.

methods.name: getLastKnownGatewayForDevice
methods.description: Retrieves the last known gateway for a specific device via the Device Connection API.
